popover_language_line.description: Word card (slice 19): the word's language in the interface language, then in the language itself, e.g. "Russian · русский". Shown alone when the two are the same.

popover_other_base.description: Word card: the meaning saved for another of the learner's languages, e.g. "In Spanish: perro". $BASE$ is a language name in the interface language.

popover_careful.description: Word card: how the word sounds said slowly and clearly, e.g. "Slowly: pa-ZHA-lu-sta". The capitals mark the stressed syllable.

popover_pron_ai.description: Word card: after the romanization, says the pronunciation was written by the AI model and not checked against a dictionary.

popover_pron_checked.description: Word card: the pronunciation agrees with a dictionary. $SOURCE$ is its name, e.g. Wiktionary.

popover_pron_differs.description: Word card: a dictionary ($SOURCE$, e.g. Wiktionary) puts the stress on another syllable than the AI's pronunciation.

popover_pron_a11y.description: Word card, read by screen readers only: the pronunciation in lowercase and the stressed syllable, e.g. "Pronunciation: pa-zhal-sta, stress on zhal".

popover_pron_a11y_plain.description: Word card, read by screen readers only: the pronunciation of a word without stress (Mandarin, Japanese, French).

popover_romanization_a11y.description: Word card, read by screen readers only: the word written in Latin letters, e.g. "Romanization: pozhaluysta".

popover_tone.description: Word card, read by screen readers only: a Mandarin or Cantonese tone number after a syllable, e.g. "tone 4".

popover_also.description: Word card: other words saved for the same meaning, e.g. "Also: bitte · por favor".

popover_more.description: Word card: button that shows the rest of a long note.

popover_dialog_label.description: Word card, for screen readers: the dialog's name, the word and its language, e.g. "спасибо, Russian".

popover_removed.description: Short message on the page when the word whose card was open was deleted meanwhile.
